about_the_game:
• Lucian, on what seemed like an ordinary school day, suddenly finds himself trapped in a deserted, post-apocalyptic world. The once lively corridors of his school are now silent and filled with shadows and unknown dangers. Together with Elora, he must rely on cooperation and determination to survive. Players must use both their intelligence and courage to solve puzzles, unlock doors, and uncover hidden paths.

    With the constant threat of lurking creatures, every step heightens the tension. Staying silent, moving strategically, and avoiding sudden dangers are key to survival. The immersive atmosphere, detailed environments, and impactful sound design create a truly tense horror experience.

    But Lucian and Elora’s journey is not only about escape — as dark secrets and mysterious events unfold, players slowly uncover the truth behind this abandoned world. Every choice, every solution, directly affects their chance of survival. This is not just a horror game; it is a story-driven experience that tests wit, strategy, and bravery.

  • Thrilling third-person survival horror gameplay

  • Story-driven experience with puzzles and mysteries

  • Stealth and strategy-focused survival mechanics

  • Immersive sound design and tense atmosphere

  • The deepening journey of Lucian and Elora

name: Ruins Of Fear

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i3-7100 / AMD Ryzen 3 2200U or equal
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon 540X 4GB / Nvidia GTX 1050 4GB or equal
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: System requirements are based on GTX 1060 6GB, I could not test it with other systems.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6 GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 8 GB or equal
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: System requirements are based on GTX 1060 6GB, I could not test it with other systems.

short_description: Lucian wakes up on an ordinary school day to find himself in a deserted world. Together with Elora, he must solve puzzles, evade creatures in dark corridors, and uncover the mysteries around him.
supported_languages:
English, German, Turkish*
